identity_policy: name is the sound-request name (NAME/REQD); wave is the verified WAVE index; layers is the FULL set of waves in the sound, including the primary (layers[0] == wave). confidence is identity confidence only; 0x21 fidelity is a separate field and is medium for every row. ghidra rows require reqd+tone and must pass the actual SEQD/PLAY_TONE walk; audition rows require verified_index=true and are explicitly not chain-proven.
note: The S8 slice: the S6 ten plus the Agro riding cues, one event per variant (agro.hoof_walk.0-9, agro.hoof_gallop.0-4, player.whistle.0-2, player.stop_horse.0-1), each variant row carrying variant_of = its base event and sharing the base sound-request name; the single-wave cues (agro.hoof_trot, agro.neigh, agro.mount, player.kick) are plain rows. All S8 rows are audition picks (method audition, none chain-proven); confidences from docs/notes/s8-recon.md. Still deferred: player.fall and the ambience/bed cues.
